sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Committee recommendation: Do Not Invest (score -0.69; 1 positive / 5 negative of 6 agents). Dissent: MarketAgent (positive).

sections.title: Market Analysis
body: Verdict: positive (score 72/100, confidence 87%).
Games campaigns fund at 44% vs a 40% platform baseline (lift 1.09).
Market timing is favorable; the Games trend is rising (22,878 campaigns).
The category is crowded.

sections.title: Competitive Landscape
body: Verdict: negative (score 17/100, confidence 99%).
Ask for less: funded campaigns' median goal is $5,000 vs $10,000 for those that failed.
Your $30,516 goal is 6.1x the winners' median ($5,000) — priced like the campaigns that failed.
Category is crowded — 22,878 campaigns (9% of all).

sections.title: Founder Assessment (creator execution)
body: Verdict: negative (score 36/100, confidence 83%).
The creator left ~42 points of controllable upside unrealized (24% of a reachable 66%) — craft gaps below.
Craft gap: Shorten your campaign from 29 to 15 days (~30 pts).
Craft gap: Lower your funding goal from $30,516 to $5,000 (~12 pts).

sections.title: Financial Assessment (funding viability)
body: Verdict: negative (score 24/100, confidence 78%).
Goal $30,516 is 6.1x the category winners' median ($5,000).

sections.title: Risks & Red Flags
body: Overall risk: High. Modeled failure risk 76%.
High — Goal $30,516 is 6.1x the Games funded-median ($5,000); large goals are harder to reach.
High — Modeled failure risk 76% (funding probability 24%, below the 33% threshold).
3 investor objection(s) raised; top: goal_size.
Investor objection (High): Your $30,516 goal is high for Games, where funded campaigns typically ask a median of $5,000. Why this ask — and can you hit it?
Investor objection (Medium): The model estimates only a 24% funding probability — below the ~33% decision threshold. How will you beat these odds?
Investor objection (Medium): Among campaigns most like yours (Games, a large goal), only 31% funded. What sets you apart from the 4,712 that came before?
